title: Jane Street Secures Crusoe’s AI Cloud Services in Five-Year, $13 Billion Deal - Bloomberg
ai_summary: Crusoe signed a five-year cloud contract with Jane Street Group valued at around $13 billion, providing AI chips and infrastructure for training and inference. The deal, reported by people with knowledge of the matter, is a significant commitment for both companies.

title: Neocloud Crusoe puts Aalo nuclear power to the AI data center test
ai_summary: Crusoe and Aalo have launched a six-month trial testing Aalo's small modular reactor (SMR) technology with Crusoe's modular Spark AI data center to assess capacity factor, load following capabilities, and energy storage integration for AI workloads. The companies are targeting commercial nuclear-powered AI data center deployments by 2029, aiming to prove the economics of modular SMR technology that can be mass-manufactured and flexibly deployed. Before commercial rollouts can proceed domestically, Aalo must obtain approval from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission and address growing community skepticism around data center facilities.

title: Poll Finds 58% Oppose Local Data Centers as Issue Reshapes Midterm Campaigns – NaturalNews.com
ai_summary: A June Yale Program on Climate Communication poll found that 58% of registered voters oppose data-center construction in their local areas, with opposition spanning political party lines, and more than 300 municipalities have enacted bans or moratoriums on hyperscale facilities. The Trump administration is developing a policy requiring major tech companies to cover electricity, water, and grid infrastructure costs for AI data centers, with Amazon and other operators signing the Ratepayer Protection Pledge. Data Center Watch reported $130 billion in major projects delayed or canceled in Q1 2026, including Brookfield-backed Compass Datacenters abandoning a Northern Virginia project and Crusoe pausing a Wyoming campus, as the backlash has become a key midterm campaign issue forcing candidates in both parties to adjust their positions.
